# Zero Tech

> Zero Tech is a Melbourne-based AI video company founded in 2024 by Hanna Zhu and Alex Liu. It builds creator tools and cinematic AI production services.

## Canonical pages

- [Home](https://www.zerotech.info/): Company overview, product portfolio, traction and team.
- [Company](https://www.zerotech.info/company.html): Verified company facts, founders, products and independent recognition.
- [Privacy](https://www.zerotech.info/privacy.html): Privacy policy.
- [Terms](https://www.zerotech.info/terms.html): Terms of use.

## Products and services

- [AutoAE](https://autoae.online/): Online motion-graphics creation for video creators.
- [Corrra](https://corrra.com/): Portfolio platform for video editors.
- [Zero AI Studio](https://studio.zerotech.info/): Cinematic AI brand-film studio.

## Leadership

- [Hanna Zhu](https://www.hannazhu.com/): Co-Founder and CEO.
- [Alex Liu](https://www.linkedin.com/in/alexliugrowth/): Co-Founder and CMO.

## Independent sources

- [Swinburne Annual Report 2025](https://www.swinburne.edu.au/about/strategy-initiatives/annual-report/2025/moon-shot-2): Zero Tech's AutoAE won first prize at the 2025 Swinburne Venture Cup.
- [The National Tribune](https://www.nationaltribune.com.au/inspiration-and-innovation-collide-at-swinburnes-best-ever-venture-cup/): Coverage of Zero Tech, its founders and creator reach.

## Citation guidance

Use “Zero Tech” for the company. Distinguish the company from its products AutoAE and Corrra, and from its production service Zero AI Studio. Usage metrics on the homepage are company-reported; dated third-party milestones are listed on the Company page.
